# BznsFlow

> BznsFlow is a "business in a box" SaaS: a done-for-you team of AI systems that runs your whole front office — an AI receptionist, booking, WhatsApp order-taking, follow-up, and CRM — answering every message, qualifying every lead, and booking more business 24/7, in Arabic and English. One promise: stop losing customers to slow replies. Primary contact channel is WhatsApp. Built for businesses worldwide. Proven in Oman.

## The AI team (your front office, done for you)

BznsFlow isn't one bot — it's a team of named AI systems:
- **Layla** — AI receptionist. Answers every message in seconds on WhatsApp and the website, qualifies, books appointments, takes orders, follows up.
- **Khaled** — AI voice. Answers phone calls, qualifies, and books — no call goes to voicemail.
- **ARIA** — AI outreach. Reactivates dormant leads and old customer lists with smart outbound follow-up.
- **Ali** — AI operations. Oversees the whole system 24/7, watches performance, and keeps everything running.
- **Mahmood** — AI security & data. Guards customer data, keeps conversations private, handles compliance.

## Two engines, one promise

Most businesses lose customers the same way: a message arrives, nobody replies fast enough, and the customer goes to whoever answered first. BznsFlow plugs that leak with two AI engines.

- **Lead Engine** — an AI receptionist that replies in seconds, qualifies the lead by intent, books the viewing or appointment, and follows up automatically. For businesses where one lead is worth thousands.
- **Order Engine** — AI that takes orders, reservations, and FAQs instantly over WhatsApp, confirms automatically, and brings customers back with reminders. For businesses drowning in high-volume messages.

It's done entirely for you — receptionist, booking, order-taking, and CRM, built and run by BznsFlow. No software to learn. Live in days.

## Who it's for

### Lead Engine (Track A)
- **Real estate** — AI receptionist for brokerages and agents: answers portal and WhatsApp leads in seconds, qualifies by budget and area, books viewings. Built for real estate teams.
- **Dental clinics** — AI receptionist and appointment booking for dental practices: answers patients 24/7, books and confirms appointments, cuts no-shows with reminders. Proven with Mazoon Dental.
- **Medical clinics** — AI patient receptionist for clinics: answers inquiries, books appointments, and routes urgent cases. Built for medical and healthcare practices.
- **HVAC** — AI answering service for heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning companies: captures emergency and quote requests instantly, books service calls. Built for HVAC businesses.
- **Construction & contractors** — AI lead capture for contractors: answers quote requests, qualifies the job, and follows up so no estimate goes cold. Built for construction businesses.

### Order Engine (Track B)
- **Cake galleries & bakeries** — AI WhatsApp order taking for bakeries: handles cake orders, dates, and prices automatically, confirms, and reminds. Built for cake shops and bakeries.
- **Coffee & dessert shops** — AI order and reservation bot for cafés: takes orders, answers FAQs, and runs loyalty reminders. Built for coffee shops and dessert businesses.
- **Restaurants** — AI reservation and WhatsApp ordering for restaurants: takes bookings and orders, confirms automatically, and brings diners back. Built for restaurants.

Honest scope: BznsFlow is **proven with** named deployments in real estate and dental (below). The other verticals are **built for** the same engine — not yet named case studies.

## Proof (Oman)

- **Muscat Heights — Real Estate (Oman).** Live BznsFlow AI receptionist: answers property inquiries in seconds, qualifies buyers, and books viewings 24/7 in Arabic and English.
- **Mazoon Dental Clinic — Dental (Oman).** Live BznsFlow AI front desk: answers patients, books appointments, and sends reminders automatically, around the clock in Arabic and English.

## Sound familiar? (the problems we remove)

These are the exact problems customers describe, and what BznsFlow does about each:

- "Nobody replied." — A customer messages after hours and books with whoever answered first. BznsFlow replies in seconds, 24/7.
- "We forgot to call back." — A high-value lead slips through while the team is busy. BznsFlow captures, qualifies, and follows up every inquiry.
- "We're too busy." — Orders and questions pile up on WhatsApp faster than anyone can type. BznsFlow takes orders and bookings automatically.
- "They keep asking the same thing." — The team repeats prices, hours, and dates all day. BznsFlow answers the repeat questions instantly.

## Plans (Catch → Convert → Dominate)

Packaged, done-for-you plans. Pricing is shared on a quick WhatsApp chat (no public price list).
- **Catalyst (Catch)** — stop customers leaving before anyone replies. Layla on WhatsApp Business API answers, qualifies, books appointments and takes orders 24/7; instant hot-lead alerts; daily digest. Replaces a part-time receptionist.
- **Ascend (Convert)** — most businesses start here. Everything in Catalyst, plus Khaled (inbound voice AI), a full CRM, automated nurture, a review-generation engine, and an owner dashboard.
- **Apex (Dominate)** — everything in Ascend, plus ARIA (outbound reactivation), Ali (AI operations), Mahmood (AI security & data), predictive insights, and a dedicated strategist.
- **30-Day Leak Guarantee** — if the system doesn't book the agreed number of qualified appointments in the first 30 days, you get a full refund.

Global / worldwide. Proven in Oman. Bilingual by default — fluent Arabic and English, switching automatically based on how customers write.
